title: Bar Salts Cherry Cola 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid By Vampire Vape
description: Step into a retro world of flavour with Cherry Cola from Vampire Vape's Bar Salts collection. This e-liquid is more than just a vape juice; it's a trip down memory lane. The sweet, tangy notes of ripe cherries intertwine with the effervescence of traditional cola, capturing the essence of those good old days. It's not just about tasting cherry cola—it's about experiencing the ambience of classic American diners and the euphoria of your first sip of a bubbly, chilled soda. This 10ml nic salt e-liquid is perfect for those who love their classics with a twist, offering a balance that captivates both fruit and soda beverage aficionados. If you’ve adored similar flavours found in disposable vapes, then you’ll absolutely swoon for Cherry Cola from Vampire Vape’s Bar Salts collection of 10ml Nic Salt e-liquids with non-disposable vapes. This premium e-liquid boasts a 50VG/50PG ratio, expertly balancing flavour and vapour. Perfect for starter kits and pod systems, its nicotine salt formulation offers a smooth, gratifying throat hit—especially ideal for those fresh off cigarettes. Nicotine Salt E-liquids are absorbed swiftly, making them a great choice for immediate relief from nicotine cravings. Looking for something a bit different? Check out the Bar Salts collection by Vampire Vape, featuring many other exciting flavours like Cherry Ice, Blue Sour Raspberry and Pineapple Ice. These 10ml e-liquids can be used in starter kits and pod kits and they allow you to enjoy your favourite flavours for far longer than a 2ml disposable vape device, all while reducing plastic waste. And because they share the same nicotine salt formulation as their disposable cousins, Vampire Vape Bar Salts deliver all the satisfying relief from nicotine cravings along with a super-smooth throat hit for comfortable, effective and enjoyable all-day vaping.
